sv.title: Anthropic faller i AI-frossan
sv.summary: USA-börserna var på ett fortsatt uselt humör i fredagens inledande handel. AI-jätten Anthropic fick en smakstart på karriären som noterat bolag, men på fredagen var det andra bullar och aktien rasar.

en.title: Anthropic falls in AI chill
en.summary: US stock exchanges were in a continued dismal mood in Friday's opening trade. AI giant Anthropic got a rocky start to its career as a listed company, but on Friday it was a different story and the share is plunging.
